  # 🥋 1. 核心角色置顶
  <Subject 1> is the breathtakingly handsome 21-year-old Chinese male instructor Shi Che (<Picture 1>) [reference image, copy this exact appearance], featuring god-tier sculpted facial bone structure, charismatic deep amber eyes, straight high nose bridge, razor-sharp jawline, clean athletic airy comma bangs, broad athletic shoulders, wearing a plain white cotton Dobok uniform with a black trim V-neck collar and tied black belt, bare feet on mat.
  Acoustic Bio-Identity (S1):
    - Base Timbre: Clear, commanding yet warm 21-year-old Chinese male baritone voice with steady cadence and crisp resonant projection.
    - Negative Vocal Locks: Strictly NO broadcasting announcer delivery, NO aggressive shouting, NO melodramatic villain cadence.
  
  <Subject 2> is the row of 8 young child martial arts students in white uniforms seen from behind bowing deeply toward the instructor.

  # 🖼️ 2. 首帧关键帧图后置
  <Picture 2> is the first frame of [Shot 1] (P02A.jpeg), establishing the medium shot of instructor Shi Che standing centered on the blue tatami mat with 8 students in foreground bowing deeply.

  # 🏛️ 3. 场景空间底图后置
  <Subject 3> is the spacious Taekwondo dojo interior in <Picture 2> (<Picture 3>).

summary:
  A 5-second cinematic medium shot starting directly from <Picture 2> where the instructor stands tall, claps his hands to announce dismissal, and bows respectfully in return as the children cheer.

retention_analysis:
  <Subject 1>: fully_preserved standing center frame throughout the entire 5 seconds based on <Picture 1>.
  <Subject 2>: fully_preserved in foreground bowing throughout and beginning to rise at the end.
  <Picture 2>: used as the first frame anchor of [Shot 1].
  <Subject 3>: fully_preserved as the sunlit training hall in [Shot 1] based on <Picture 3>.

detailed_description:
  The target video is in live-action photorealistic high-stakes Chinese urban drama cinema style, shot on ARRI Alexa LF with Cooke Anamorphic 50mm Prime lens at T2.0, physical cine lens with organic 35mm Kodak Vision3 500T film grain, authentic high-budget television drama quality, 100% matching human skin texture and dojo materials of reference images, zero CGI render, zero 3D video game look, zero cartoon smoothing.
  [Shot 1] 47° diagonal FOV, standard normal lens, standing medium shot, steady frame with subtle natural breathing motion, no camera movement. Warm 3000K fading golden hour sunlight from window blinds casting dramatic rim light along his jawline and throat.
  FIRST FRAME DEADLOCK: The target video starts directly from the exact spatial composition in <Picture 2>, with <Subject 1> (Shi Che, defined by <Picture 1>) standing tall, upright, and centered on the blue tatami mat facing forward toward the camera with hands resting calmly at his sides. In the foreground, a row of 8 child students (<Subject 2>) in white uniforms bow deeply from the waist toward Coach Shi Che with their backs to camera.
  [0-3s] (Dismissal & Hand Clap): With a warm coaching smile, <Subject 1> (Shi Che) brings his hands up to chest level and claps twice firmly with a clear resonant snap, announcing dismissal while all foreground students maintain their bow with shut mouths. <Subject 1> (S1) <d>[Chinese] 好，今天的基本功训练到此结束。下课！</d>
  [3-5s] (Reciprocal Bow): <Subject 1> (Shi Che) lowers his hands and bows slightly at the waist with genuine respect. The foreground children cheer with joyful high-pitched laughter, beginning to straighten up and turn as the shot cleanly ends.
  CRITICAL KINETICS & PHYSICS: Crisp tactile snap of the double hand clap. Natural arm elevation from resting position to chest level without teleportation. Grounded foot stability on mat. Strict 1.0x real-time speed.
  CANVAS PURITY: 100% clean live-action cinema canvas, zero on-screen text, zero burned-in subtitle graphics, zero typography (vocal speech via <d> audio tags only, strictly no visual text rendering).

overall_soundscape:
  Pristine directional shotgun close-mic vocal pickup, highly intelligible speech clarity, dry room acoustics, strictly zero background music (NO BGM), resonant double hand clap, cheerful collective child chatter at end of shot.
